usage.title: Usage
usage.costNote: «Equivalent»: what it would cost through the API. With a subscription it is not billed separately: it counts against your limit.
usage.liveNote: The numbers come from Claude Code itself while it works. The cost appears at the end.
usage.waiting: Waiting for the first usage data.
usage.limits: With your subscription it is not billed separately: this counts against your 5-hour and weekly limit. A bigger model uses it up sooner.
usage.unavailable: {{provider}} gives no tokens or cost in this mode. We do not show numbers that are not real.
usage.copilotWarn: Copilot charges AI credits based on tokens (input, output and cache) and the model. This app cannot measure them in this mode: check your usage on GitHub before and after.
usage.creditsNote: Measured by Copilot itself (≈). They are deducted from your GitHub AI credits; the exact total is on your Copilot usage page.
usage.creditsLimits: Copilot counts AI credits by tokens (input, output and cache) and model; a larger model spends them faster.

sent.title: What was sent
sent.text: Only names and sizes; the content is not kept in this report. None of it leaves your computer except to {{provider}}.

foot.live: It updates by itself while the AI works. Closing it does not stop it.
foot.done: It also helps to diagnose: copy the report and paste it where you need (without the content of your PDFs).

diag.title: Why it ended with «no changes»
diag.tip: Use a version with text, or «Copy and adjust by texts» if B does have text.
diag.no_text_a: The PDF of A has no readable text (usually a scan or a PDF made of images). The AI sees the pages, but the app needs texts to calculate coordinates.
diag.no_text_b: The PDF of B has no readable text (usually a scan or a PDF made of images). The AI sees the pages, but the app needs texts to calculate coordinates.
diag.permission_denied: {{provider}} could not open the files it was given (permission denied). Check its session and try again.
diag.no_valid_answer: The AI answer was not a valid list with one object per field, not even on the retry.
diag.anchors_not_found: The AI proposed anchor texts that do not exist in the PDFs. It usually happens when the wording changed a lot.
diag.ai_found_nothing: The AI answered that it cannot place any of the fields.
diag.partial: Some fields could not be placed; the review list shows the reason for each one.
diag.cap_reached: The limit of 8 requests for this PDF was reached: what was placed so far is returned. Check the missing fields by hand.

cmd.putAdjust: Put template A · adjust by texts
cmd.putAi: Put template A · adapt with AI

projects.title: Projects

adopt.title: You have a batch without a project
adopt.text: A batch of {{count}} PDFs is saved only in this browser. You can save it as an «Untitled» project in a folder on your disk.

rootError.title: The projects folder cannot be opened
rootError.text: «{{root}}» does not exist or you have no permission (network drive disconnected?). Nothing was deleted.

empty.title: You have no projects yet
empty.text: A project groups the PDFs of a client and is saved in a folder on your disk. You do not need one to annotate a single PDF.

size.warn: Close to the limit: consider splitting it into two projects.
size.full: Project full: no more PDFs can be added.

projects.takeoverText: {{host}} has it open (last seen at {{time}}). If you take over, that computer becomes read-only and may lose unsaved changes.
projects.forgetText: No file is deleted. The PDFs and your work stay on your disk, in this folder:
projects.forgetTextEmpty: No file is deleted. The folder has no PDFs yet and stays on your disk:
projects.forgetNote: If you later import another project with this name and the folder is still there, it will be saved in a new folder (for example “{{folder}}-2”) so files are never mixed.
projects.forgetSync: It also stops syncing. What is already synced stays as it is.
projects.forgottenWhere: “{{name}}” removed from the list. The files are still in {{path}}.
projects.created: Project «{{name}}» created and saved on your disk.
projects.forgotten: «{{name}}» removed from the list (the files are still on your disk).

error.root-missing: The projects folder does not exist.
error.denied: No permission to write to the projects folder.
error.io: Could not read or write to the disk.
error.exists: A project with that name already exists in that folder.
error.bad-name: Enter a name for the project.
error.bad-item: That PDF cannot be saved in the project.
error.not-a-project: That folder is not a project.
error.not-held: Another computer took the project: you stay read-only and changes are not saved.
error.pdf-too-big: That PDF is larger than {{max}} MB, the maximum per PDF.
error.too-many-pdfs: The project already has 200 PDFs, the maximum. Split it into two projects.
error.too-big: The project would reach 2 GB, the maximum. Split it into two projects.
error.lockLost: Another computer took the project: you stay read-only and changes are not saved.
error.empty: Nothing to export: the project has no PDFs.
error.busy: An export or import is already running.
error.not-an-archive: That file is not a PDF Annotator project.
error.newer-format: The file comes from a newer version of the app.
error.in-use: The project is in use on another computer.
error.in-use-local: Something has the folder open (File Explorer, an antivirus or the cloud client). Close it and try again. The project has not changed.
error.folder-gone: Could not open the folder: it no longer exists on the disk. It may have been moved or deleted.

drop.title: Drop a .pdfannotator file here to import it
drop.text: It will be checked before anything is created.

transfer.exportIntro: Creates a file with everything needed to open the project on another computer.
transfer.warnText: The PDFs may contain personal data and the file is not encrypted. Share it only through channels you trust.
transfer.readOnlyText: {{host}} has it open. You can still export: what is saved is read and nothing is changed.
transfer.keepBrowsing: You can keep looking at the project, but not change it until this finishes.
transfer.exportCanceled: Export canceled. No file was saved.
transfer.exportFailed: The export did not finish: no partial file was left behind.
transfer.emptyText: This project has no PDFs yet. Add some and export again.
transfer.verified: File checked: structure, types and checksums are correct
transfer.conflictTitle: A project with that name already exists
transfer.conflictText: «{{name}}» is already in {{ref}} ({{pdfs}} PDFs, {{done}} ready, edited {{when}}).
transfer.copyText: Saved with a new name and folder. Nothing you already have is touched.
transfer.replaceText: Replaces the current project with the one in the file. Changes that are not in the file are lost.
transfer.replaceConfirmText: It will be replaced by the contents of the file. This would be lost:
transfer.lossOnlyHere: {{count}} PDFs that exist only in your project
transfer.lossChanged: Changes in {{count}} PDFs edited after the file was exported
transfer.lossNone: Nothing that is not already in the file.
transfer.safetyText: Before replacing, a copy is kept in «{{name}} (before import)». You can delete it whenever you like.
transfer.inUseText: «{{name}}» is in use on {{host}}. Ask them to close it, or import a new copy.
transfer.importedSkippedOne: Imported with 1 warning: «{{name}}» ({{size}}) was left out.
transfer.importedSkippedMany: Imported with warnings: {{count}} PDFs over {{max}} MB were left out.
transfer.oversizeOne: «{{name}}» is {{size}} and the maximum per PDF is {{max}} MB. The rest of the project is fine.
transfer.oversizeMany: {{count}} PDFs are over {{max}} MB, the maximum per PDF: {{names}}… The rest of the project is fine.
transfer.optSkipHint: You are told which ones were left out.

err.notArchiveText: «{{name}}» is not a project file. Projects are exported as .pdfannotator.
err.corruptText: The checksum of {{file}} does not match and the import was canceled. Nothing was created in your projects folder.
err.corruptGeneric: The file is incomplete or damaged and the import was canceled. Nothing was created in your projects folder.
err.unsafeText: It contains a path outside the project ({{file}}). It was rejected as a whole and nothing was written.
err.newerText: This file uses format {{format}} and this version only understands up to {{supported}}. Update the app and try again.
err.tooBigText: It has {{pdfs}} PDFs and {{size}}; the maximum is {{maxPdfs}} PDFs and {{maxSize}}. Ask whoever exported it to split it into two projects.
err.diskFullText: Whatever was half written was deleted; your projects folder is as it was. Free some space and try again.
err.diskFullExport: No half-written file was left behind. Free some space or pick another drive and try again.

transfer.targetTaken: The folder “{{ref}}” already has files from a project removed from the list. They are left untouched: this project will be imported into “{{next}}”.

meta.pend: Changes not yet uploaded to the linked folder.
meta.pull: {{by}} uploaded revision {{rev}}. You can get it.

dups.link: There are duplicate files in the folder
dups.title: There are duplicate files in the folder
dups.text: The service that syncs the folder created conflict copies. The app does not use or delete them:

link.title: Sync with a folder
link.intro: Pick a folder you already sync (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox…) or a network folder. The app will keep a copy of your projects there so you can open them on another computer.
link.checked: Folder checked: readable and writable · {{free}} free
link.warnText: The PDFs will leave this computer for that folder and travel through the service that syncs it. The app does not encrypt them. Only use folders you trust.
link.accept: I understand the PDFs and their data will be copied to that folder

plan.title: What should go to the linked folder?
plan.intro: There are {{local}} projects on this computer and {{remote}} in the folder that you do not have here.
plan.both: Upload my projects and download the ones in the folder
plan.bothHint: If a name matches, you are asked before anything is touched. Your projects add up to {{size}}.
plan.down: Only download the ones in the folder
plan.downHint: Your projects stay on this computer until you upload each one.
plan.manualHint: It is linked and nothing is uploaded or downloaded until you ask from each card’s ⋯ menu.

progress.title: Syncing “{{name}}”
progress.note: Only files that changed are uploaded or downloaded. You can cancel: the previous revision stays intact.

done.up: “{{name}}” uploaded (revision {{rev}}). It may take a few minutes to show up on other computers.
done.allIssues: Sync finished with warnings: {{failed}} projects could not be synced and {{conflicts}} need a decision.
done.linked: Folder linked. Projects you sync are uploaded when you close them and every few minutes.
done.stopped: “{{name}}” is no longer synced. It stays on this computer.
done.unlinked: Folder unlinked. Your projects are still here.

conflict.title: “{{name}}” has changed in the folder
conflict.text: {{by}} uploaded revision {{rev}} and you have changes that are not uploaded. The app overwrites nothing unless you decide.
conflict.takenTitle: Another project already uses that path in the folder
conflict.takenText: “{{name}}” and the one in the folder share a name but are different projects.
conflict.optTheirs: Keep the folder’s version and save mine as a copy
conflict.optTheirsHint: Your work is kept as a separate project and revision {{rev}} is used.
conflict.optMine: Upload mine and replace the folder’s version
conflict.optMineHint: Revision {{rev}} is replaced by yours. A copy of what is replaced is kept in the folder first, just in case.
conflict.optLaterHint: The project stays as it is, unsynced, until you choose.

offline.title: The linked folder cannot be found
offline.text: “{{folder}}” is not responding (network down, sync service closed or disk unplugged?). You can keep working: changes will wait as “Waiting to upload” and go up when it is back.

host-not-found.title: The server cannot be found
host-not-found.text: “{{host}}” does not respond (no network, wrong name, server off or port {{port}} blocked). You can keep working: changes will stay “Waiting to upload”.

connect-timeout.title: Timed out
connect-timeout.text: The server took more than 15 s to respond. If you use a VPN, check that it is connected. Local work keeps working.

connection-refused.title: The server refuses the connection
connection-refused.text: “{{host}}” is on the network but does not accept SSH connections on port {{port}}. Check that the SSH service is running.

connection-lost.title: The connection was lost
connection-lost.text: The connection to “{{host}}” dropped. Nothing was lost: the previous revision is intact and it will be retried when it is back.

stop.title: Stop syncing “{{name}}”?
stop.text: The project stays on this computer as it is and stops being uploaded or downloaded.
stop.noteTitle: What happens to the copy in the folder
stop.noteText: What you already uploaded stays there and the app does not delete it. To remove it, do it from your system (Explorer or Finder).

unlink.title: Unlink the folder?
unlink.text: The link to “{{folder}}” is removed. Your projects stay here; what you already uploaded stays in the folder and the app does not delete it.

err.title: Could not sync
err.folder-missing: The linked folder cannot be found.
err.folder-readonly: That folder cannot be written to. It looks read-only: pick another or change its permissions.
err.folder-overlaps: That folder will not work: it cannot be inside your projects folder or contain it.
err.remote-incomplete: Files are missing in the folder (“{{detail}}”). That is normal if the other computer is still uploading: try again in a few minutes.
err.cloud-pending: “{{detail}}” is still downloading from the cloud. Open the folder, choose “Always keep on this device” (or wait for it to finish) and try again.
err.ref-taken: Another project already uses that path in the folder.
err.in-use-local: Close it before getting changes from another computer.
err.in-use: {{detail}} has it open. It can be uploaded once they close it.
err.disk-full: Not enough space: about {{detail}} MB missing. Nothing was left half-written.
err.newer-format: This folder is used by a newer version of the app. Update and try again.
err.host-key-changed: The server fingerprint changed: nothing was sent. Confirm it with whoever runs the server.
err.host-key-unknown: The server fingerprint has to be confirmed first.
err.host-not-found: The server cannot be found (no network, wrong name or server off).
err.connect-timeout: The server took too long to respond.
err.connection-refused: The server does not accept SSH connections on that port.
err.connection-lost: The connection to the server was lost. The previous revision is intact; it will be retried when it is back.
err.key-unusable: The key cannot be used: the file does not exist, cannot be read or is not a valid private key (OpenSSH and PEM are supported).
err.secret-needed: Enter the server password to connect.
err.remote-missing: The folder does not exist on the server.
err.rename-unsupported: The server does not allow renaming files in that folder. Without that, nothing can be guaranteed not to be left half-written, so nothing is uploaded.
err.lock-expired: Your lock on the server expired: another computer may have opened this project. Close it and open it again.
err.already-linked: A destination is already linked. Unlink it before choosing another.
err.bad-sftp-config: Server details are missing or invalid.

sftp.title: Sync with an SFTP server
sftp.intro: Use a server you already have (a NAS, a VPS, your company’s). The app will keep a copy of your projects there so you can open them on another computer.
sftp.remember: Remember the credential in the secure store
sftp.rememberHint: If not, it is asked each time you open the app.
sftp.credText: It is stored with your system’s encryption (Keychain, DPAPI or libsecret). It is not stored anywhere else and never appears in exported files.
sftp.warnText: Your PDFs will leave this computer for that server over SSH and are not encrypted on the server. Only use servers you trust.
sftp.accept: I understand the PDFs and their data will be copied to that server

step.login: Sign-in works: fingerprint confirmed and credential accepted
step.folder: The folder on the server is available
step.folderBad: The folder on the server was not found
step.write: Reading, writing and renaming work there
step.writeBad: Writing or renaming is not possible there

hostkey.textNew: This is the first time you connect to “{{host}}”. Check that this fingerprint matches the one given by whoever runs the server.
hostkey.warnText: If you cannot check it, cancel. Accepting a fake fingerprint would let a third party see your PDFs.
hostkey.textChanged: The server may have been reinstalled, or someone may be impersonating it. For safety nothing was sent and the credential was not used.
hostkey.blockedText: Confirm the change with whoever runs the server before accepting it.
hostkey.pinned: New fingerprint pinned. You can sync now.

text.auth: The server rejected the saved credential. Enter the new one; the old one is replaced in the secure store.
text.passphrase: The key “{{file}}” could not be opened with that passphrase.
text.ask: It is not saved on this computer. It will only be used while the app is open.
text.change: Enter the new one; the old one is replaced. The current one cannot be read back.

cred.forgotten: Credential forgotten. Next time you will have to enter it.

nostore.title: The password cannot be saved
nostore.text: This computer has no secure store available (on Linux the keyring is often missing). For safety the app does not save it in any file.
nostore.ask: Ask for it each time I open the app
nostore.askHint: It works the same; you only type the password once per session.
nostore.installHint: For example gnome-keyring or KWallet. It is tried again when you close this notice.

server.title: Server and credentials
server.credSession: Only for this session (no secure store)
server.credNone: Not saved: it will be asked when connecting

forget.title: Forget the credential for “{{host}}”?
forget.text: It is deleted from this computer’s secure store. Projects and what was already uploaded are untouched; next time you will have to enter it.

unlinkSftp.title: Unlink the server?
unlinkSftp.text: The link with “{{label}}” is removed and the credential is deleted from this computer. Your projects stay here; what you already uploaded stays on the server and the app does not delete it.

rename.menuOther: Rename… · in use on another computer
rename.title: Rename project
rename.empty: Enter a name for the project.
rename.folderHint: The project folder changes with the name.
rename.folderOff: Unchecked because the folder “{{folder}}” is not named like the project. Only the name you see in the app changes.
rename.folderSynced: Not available while the project is synced: the path is the sync key. Only the name you see in the app changes.
rename.keepParent: Only the last part changes: “{{parent}}” stays as it is.
rename.warnChars: Invalid characters are removed from the folder name: it becomes “{{folder}}”.
rename.warnReserved: “{{name}}” is a reserved Windows name. The folder will be called “{{folder}}”; the visible name does not change.
rename.caseOnly: On this system both spellings are the same folder; it is renamed anyway.
rename.clash: “{{parent}}” already has a folder called “{{folder}}”. Choose another name or uncheck the box to change only the visible name.
rename.doneKept: Name changed. The folder stays as “{{folder}}” because the project is synced.
rename.locked: {{host}} opened the project while you were typing. Nothing was renamed.

templatesExport.title: Export templates
templatesExport.intro: Choose the templates you want to take with you. They are saved in a single ZIP, one JSON per template.
templatesExport.empty: You have no saved templates yet. Save one from Annotations and come back.
templatesExport.doneText: {{n}} templates · {{kb}} KB. Find it in your downloads folder.
templatesExport.errorText: The ZIP could not be created. Your templates are still saved and nothing was lost.

pairing.otherPageA: Its field of A is on page {{page}} of A (with linked pages A follows B).
